_instructions: Copy this file to local.settings.json (gitignored) and fill in your values.
You must also set the corresponding GAS script properties in the Apps Script editor:
Apps Script -> Project Settings -> Script Properties -> Add property
GAS_LOGGER_FOLDER_ID  = Drive folder ID of the folder referenced by gasLogDir below
AXIOM_TOKEN           = same value as axiomToken below (INGEST token)
AXIOM_DATASET         = same value as axiomDataset below
To find a Drive folder ID: open the folder in Google Drive, copy the
alphanumeric ID from the URL:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID_HERE>
gasLogDir must be the local filesystem path where Google Drive for Desktop
maps the GAS_LOGGER_FOLDER_ID folder. Only needed for the Drive driver.
axiomDataset is THIS REPO'S OWN dataset, named after the repo, lowercased.
Do NOT point a second project at an existing dataset. An Axiom dataset caps
at 257 fields; past the cap, new field names are SILENTLY DROPPED at ingest
while the POST still returns 2xx. A shared dataset spends one exhaustible
budget, and the repo that exhausts it is not the repo that breaks. See
README.md 'The Four Standing Rules' section 1.
axiomToken      INGEST ONLY (write). Server-side only -- its destination is
the AXIOM_TOKEN script property. No local tool reads it.
axiomQueryToken READ ONLY (query). What tools/query_axiom.py and
axiom-log-helpers.js use. Lives on developer laptops only,
and must never be written to a script property.
Mint both in the Axiom org's Settings -> API Tokens page, each scoped to this
repo's dataset. An ingest token cannot query: handing the query tool the wrong
one produces a 401/403, which query_axiom.py calls out explicitly.
Without these, GasLogger still works -- it just writes Drive NDJSON only.
--- axiomEnv (OPTIONAL, COMPATIBILITY ONLY) -------------------------------
Omit this block. The canonical emitter stamps a top-level `env` column
(BUILD_INFO.env, vocabulary dev|test|prod) and query_axiom.py's defaults
already understand every legacy spelling of those values.
Only a repo whose emitter stamps the environment on a DIFFERENT FIELD needs
it -- e.g. an older logger that stamps `target` with TEST/TEMPLATE:
"axiomEnv": {"field": "target",
"values": {"sit": ["TEST"], "test": ["TEST"],
"prod": ["TEMPLATE"]}}
This is a migration affordance so --env works before the emitter is fixed.
Needing a non-default `field` means you have an emitter to bring to the
standard; it is not an alternative to doing so.
Required only for gas-log-helpers.js's axiomProbeLatency/assertNoLog
sentinel-watermark helpers (see README.md 'Sentinel-Watermark Waits'). They
point at a deployment/test-only WebApp route that calls
GasLogger.log('test.axiom_probe', {sentinel}) + flush() -- the probe must go
through the real GAS->Axiom path, not a test-process-direct-to-Axiom
shortcut, or it would understate real ingest latency.
